title: Length of the unary product output
statement: For any two finite bit strings $a$ and $b$, the output of the unary multiplication procedure on their self-delimiting pair encoding has length $|a|\,|b|$, where $|a|$ and $|b|$ denote the numbers of bits in the strings.
